messages:
Nina (CS): Quick flag  03:37 UTC: some EU onboarding sign-ins returned 401 during SSO token exchange. I exported the impacted set (10 trials, 2 enterprise). Dropping here to coordinate customer messaging and remedial offers. Link: https://go/internal/cs/impacted-sso (view-only).
Omar (eng-oncall): Looking at logs. Provider returned invalid_client on /oauth/token for eu-1. Early hypothesis: provider rotated client secret; our eu adapter didn't pick it up. Kicked off secrets-resync to secretstore-eu. ETA ~18m.
Priyanka (CS Ops): Recommend we send a short targeted status to affected accounts noting restoration time, provide 2 quick troubleshooting steps, and offer 14d credit for trials + 1:1 onboarding for enterprise. I can book sessions if Legal OKs credits.
Cal (Product): Which enterprise accounts? Any in active renewal windows? Need to triage renewals.
Nina (CS): Impacted enterprise: NovaHealth (onboarding) and PixelWorks (pilot). NovaHealth in renewal review in ~5 weeks. Flagging as higher priority.
Jo (Legal): Credits are fine. Please use neutral phrasing and "we apologize for the inconvenience". Avoid contractual-SLA phrasing. Also prefer "service was restored for affected users as of <time>" rather than "we restored service."
ops-bot: secrets-resync-job: started (job-id 2026-07-04-0338)
Omar (eng-oncall): Resync completed 03:55 UTC. All provider keys synced to secretstore-eu. Token error rate back to baseline by 03:58 UTC. Root cause: provider key rotation + missing key-rotation webhook for eu-1. Remediation plan: add webhook + region smoke test + alerting (owner: Omar). Postmortem scheduled for 10:00 UTC.
Nina (CS): Drafting customer note below for Legal review.
Nina (CS): --- CUSTOMER UPDATE DRAFT ---
Hi <CustomerName>,
Were writing about a brief authentication issue that affected some EU onboarders earlier today. Service was restored for affected users as of 03:58 UTC. If youre still seeing 401s, please try a fresh browser sign-in and include the request timestamp and x-rw-trace header in your reply so our team can investigate quickly.
We apologize for the inconvenience. As a gesture, weve applied a two-week credit for affected trials and scheduled a complimentary 1:1 onboarding session for impacted enterprise accounts. To book troubleshooting office hours, please use: https://cal.link/redwood-cs/office-hours.
If you have questions, reply to this message or contact your CS rep directly.
---
Jo (Legal): Approved with wording tweak: replace "we restored" with "service was restored for affected users as of 03:58 UTC" (already included). Good to send.
Priyanka (CS Ops): I'll send personalized notes to NovaHealth and PixelWorks now and schedule 1:1s. I'll capture any renewal signals in the renewal tracker.
ops-bot: secrets-resync-job: success (job-id 2026-07-04-0338) - 100 keys synced
Omar (eng-oncall): Monitoring confirms error rate returned to baseline by 03:58 UTC. Postmortem will include timeline, log excerpts, and remediation tasks (webhook + smoke tests + runbook update).
Nina (CS): Sent customer notes at 04:05 UTC to the impacted list and posted a short portal status. Will update this thread if any replies indicate churn risk or exec escalation.
